limitations: Small fixed case sample; not population accuracy.
Diagnostic retrieval is post-treatment behavior, not a randomized subgroup.
Search timing is provisional; no automatic verdict or safe-candidate certification.
Provider internal request retries and immutable model revision are unobserved.
Four trajectories interrupted by ENOSPC; no route-effect estimate or success-rate comparison.
Four observed sessions lack completed proposal records, six planned slots were not started; never score these as operator failures.
One selected convolution source came from a trajectory interrupted after three recorded proposals; separate from completed trajectories.
Contemporary manual drift checks have one process per source; archived controls have three. No interleaved causal timing design.

confirmations.review: D4096 partitioned into four disjoint 1024-column chunks per token. Each block writes all four output heads. comb row index = 4*k+h for every accumulator. Token dimension uses one block group per token; no token floor division.

Three disjoint 512-column Q/K/V partitions. Each block preserves token order and performs all InOut shifts for its columns; two-row history is loaded before overlapping shift store. FP32 addition regrouping needs numerical validation. No cross-block state-column overlap.

Eight-token groups and four disjoint 1024-column chunks. All chunk sums contribute before normalization; all columns written. Source-level valid range T divisible by8. T13 is outside this candidate range; it is not generic dynamic-T support.

Eight-token groups, four disjoint1024-column chunks, complete reduction before each output; same algorithm family as repeat0 but distinct source. Valid tested range T multiple8; T13 outside this range.

Six disjoint256-column partitions cover all1536 channels. Flat Q/K/V views each receive two disjoint256-column pieces. Every block loops tokens serially and performs all three state shifts; history loaded before writes. Addition regrouping requires heldout numerical check.

Four disjoint1024-column chunks per token, four output heads per block, comb indices4*k+h. sync_start=True requires4*T not exceed runtime AIV slot limit. T8 uses32 blocks and is the configured EXAM case. T13 uses52 blocks and is expected to be rejected by runtime REQUIRE_SYNC_START_INVALID; do not classify that as a numerical error or a runtime bug. Not general dynamic-T support.
Four disjoint1024-column chunks per token; four heads per block through unroll4, comb4*k+h. No sync_start bound. Complete stores for all token groups.

Six disjoint256-column partitions. Each partition owns two of four output heads in exactly one Q/K/V tensor and all three state shifts for its channels; serial token order preserved. Selected from three verified proposals before ENOSPC, not a completed four-proposal trajectory.
